annotations.title: Get a download link for a post

description: Turn a public post URL from Pinterest, Dailymotion, Snapchat, TikTok, Douyin, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter and 808 more sites into a download.fan link that opens with the post loaded, ready to save as MP4, MP3 or JPG. YouTube is not supported.

format.description: What to save. Defaults from the URL (reel, story, photo post), else "video". Use "mp3" for audio only.

url.description: The post URL, or share text containing it.
